integration_decision: PR 175 was not merged. Its diff deletes the tested PDF/XLSX parser, hour pricing, and SQLite monitor. Copilot's assurance semantics were ported onto the PR 174 engine: exact evidence digests, conflicting monitor replay rejection, SYSTEM actor, and a hash-chained monitor log. The financial receipt already seals financial_summary. Jules' blanket invalidation of every RATE finding was not copied.
implemented: Misapplied payment: cash that names a different job than its invoice is one unverified amount and is not also an orphan or a paid-status gap
Successor rates retire only the named predecessor on or after the successor start; an unrelated period stays on its own rate
dependent_finding_ids matches the exact record digest of the superseded rate
Duplicate equipment identity and service date withhold dollars instead of summing tickets
Overtime hours without an overtime rate are withheld; straight-time approved hours can still be priced
Monitor events store prev_sha256 and entry_sha256, actor SYSTEM, and fail closed when a source digest is reused for a different checkpoint
Chain verification fails after an on-disk entry hash is changed and does not rewrite sealed financial receipts
Website Admit synthetic CSV posts a server-side CSV to POST /v1/dispater/documents and labels the response SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT
